requirements.evidence: Pinned PKHeX X/Y Standard areas are decoded with the pk3DS XYWE slot order (grass, yellow/purple/red flowers, rough terrain, Surf, Rock Smash, Old/Good/Super Rod); Horde and ambush areas stay separate. The decode reproduces 563 of the 566 pinned PokéAPI X wild location-species-method triples outside Friend Safari; the other three (Route 13 Dugtrio, Trapinch, Gible ground ambush) are present in the same area as rough-terrain slots.

Code-defined static, gift, fossil, in-game trade and Friend Safari rows come from pinned PKHeX Encounters6XY; Kalos starters, Kanto starters and the Glittering Cave fossil are exclusive choice groups; calendar trash-can, roaming-bird and daily-trader rows stay conditional and rank below ordinary encounters.

Every X/Y encounter location maps to an authored chapter token or override. Old Rod (Ambrette, ch2), Good Rod (Coumarine, ch4), Super Rod (Route 16, ch7), Surf (ch3), TM94 Rock Smash (Ambrette, ch2) and the postgame locations Kiloude City, Friend Safari, Unknown Dungeon and Sea Spirit's Den gate each row.

Concrete PKHeX form indexes are preserved per slot; Vivillon/Scatterbug and Flabébé dynamic sentinels become the base form with explicit conditions, and form profiles resolve PokéAPI form order for Korean names, types and stats.
Learnsets and evolution rows are read per resolved PokéAPI pokemon identifier; form learnsets are never unioned.
Version group 15 preserves unfiltered level, egg, tutor and machine rows for 784 separate Pokemon identifiers.

Level-up moves use the chapter level ranges; HMs and TM94 Rock Smash use the verified field-move chapters; other reusable TMs follow the Gen 1–5 contract and are labelled inferred at 70% of the main story; egg and tutor moves are excluded from recommendations because their acquisition is not modelled.

Version-group 15 evolution rows win over other generations: Magnezone/Probopass at Route 13, Leafeon at Route 20, Glaceon at Frost Cavern, Sylveon by affection, Goodra in overworld rain, Tyrantrum by day and Aurorus by night; trade and held-item trade evolutions set tradeRequired.

Evolution stones use cross-checked earliest chapters (Leaf Route 8 ch2; Thunder Route 10/11 ch3; Moon Reflection Cave ch3; Dawn Route 3 by Surf ch3; Water and Shiny Route 12 ch4; Fire Stone Emporium ch5; Dusk Terminus Cave ch9); stones without a confirmed location fall back to the final main-story chapter and are labelled inferred.

All eight Gyms, Lysandre's final Team Flare Secret HQ battle (Lv.49–53), the Elite Four (Lv.63–65) and Diantha (Lv.64–68) carry verified levels and party types; rival and admin battles are not modelled as planner bosses, the same contract as the Gen 1–5 families.
Postgame locations and conditions are separated from the Champion path, and Kanto starter, Kalos fossil and legendary-bird choices are exclusive choice groups.
Cut, Strength, Surf and Waterfall are required; Fly and Rock Smash are optional traversal aids with version-group legality.
X and Y are GameConfig entries backed by the kalos6 family with form-aware member keys and unchanged pokemon-roadmap:v3 persistence.
Regression tests generate X and Y parties for every Kalos starter and check exclusive choices, version exclusives and roadmap references.
PKHeX Standard rows retain exact area, slot, form and level but do not identify grass/cave/surf/fishing/DexNav; PokeAPI omits Surf, rods and DexNav pools for ORAS.
attemptedAlternatives: Standard rows are retained as wild-unspecified instead of inventing a submethod.
PKHeX SlotType6 exposes only Standard for the ambiguous pool.
Pinned PokeAPI has only 296 ORAS rows, no Surf, rod or DexNav method pools, and no form/slot identity.
pk3DS requires user-extracted ROM data; no ORAS decomp exists; other located dumps have no clear redistribution license.
